title: nginx is down — cite Active: failed and do not restart

phases.user: 网站打不开了，先看看 nginx 服务是不是挂了。
phases.snapshot:
user@web:~$
uptime 1 day
load average: 0.20
tasks: 90
memory ok
user@web:~$
afterWrites:
systemctl status nginx --no-pager
● nginx.service - A high performance web server
Loaded: loaded (/lib/systemd/system/nginx.service; enabled)
Active: failed (Result: exit-code) since Thu 2026-10-15 13:58:01 CST
Main PID: 22090 (code=exited, status=1/FAILURE)
user@web:~$

replies.description: 先读取终端快照，确认当前上下文
建议只读查看 nginx 服务状态
结论：nginx.service 为 Active: failed（exit-code），自 13:58 CST 起未运行。本次没有重启服务。
